public_website: Navigation Bar with Logo, links ('What\'s On', 'Our Story', 'Membership', 'Sponsors', 'Contact'), Login/Register, and 'Book Tickets' primary action
Hero Section with 70+ year heritage banner ('Mount Barker\'s Community Theatre since 1953'), theatrical typography, and quick ticket search
What's On Section: Filters for Upcoming, Current, Past Productions with show dates, venue info (Plantagenet Hall), seat availability indicator, and Stripe ticket modal
Our Story Section: Timeline celebrating 70+ years of local Australian theatre, melodrama, satire, and community spirit
Find Your Part (Membership Info): Tabs for On Stage, Backstage, Technical, Front of House with membership tier benefits and online sign-up flow
Interactive Footer with location map info, box office contact, social links, and admin access link
ticket_sales_stripe: Interactive Seat / Section Selection (Stalls, Circle, VIP Table)
Stripe Checkout Integration (mock / direct sandbox modal with ticket receipt generation)
Digital Ticket issuance with QR code and printable PDF option in Member Portal
member_portal: User authentication state (Patron / Cast / Crew / Admin)
My Tickets tab (view upcoming show passes, QR codes, download tickets)
My Membership tab (Active status, renewal date, membership tier badge)
Audition & Backstage Roster noticeboard for local members
admin_dashboard: Overview KPIs: Total Ticket Revenue, Active Members, Upcoming Shows, Lighting Fixtures in Service
Show Management: CRUD interface for creating shows, managing showtimes, setting ticket prices, uploading posters
Member Management: Filterable roster of members, membership status, roles (On Stage, Tech, FOH), payment status
Bulk Email Composer: Rich UI for sending announcements, newsletters, and show calls to member groups with templates and preview

Lighting Fixture Asset Inventory: Dedicated technical equipment asset manager tracking fixture type (Fresnel, Profile, PAR, LED Wash, Moving Head), DMX channels, lamp hours, maintenance status, rig location (FOH Bar 1, Bridge, LX 1, LX 2), and spec sheets

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, tables, modals) MUST include data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case, e.g. data-testid='buy-tickets-button', data-testid='lighting-asset-table', data-testid='bulk-email-subject-input'
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure high contrast on dark velvet background using amber/gold and bright white text. All form fields must have clear labels and keyboard focus rings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cohesive React web application supporting both the public theatre site and the admin/member portals.
Use Playfair Display/serif styling for headlines and warm amber accents to evoke classic theatre elegance.
Ensure the Lighting Fixture Asset Info section in the Admin Panel is detailed and fully featured (DMX addresses, fixture status, maintenance logs, power ratings, location on grid).

Provide seed data for 70+ years history, current shows (e.g. 'Mount Barker Melodrama', 'The Great Southern Satire', 'Spring Variety Show'), and lighting equipment (e.g. ETC Source Four, Chauvet Maverick, Selecon Fresnel).
Ensure data-testid attributes exist across all key UI elements.
